variables.comment: Current version of the parcel format.

variables.name: MAGIC
variables.comment: In-memory Parcel magic number, used to detect attempts to unmarshall bad data

variables.name: mNumAggregated
variables.comment: Number of individual stats that have been aggregated to create this one.

variables.name: mInternalSinglePssCount
variables.comment: Count and total time expended doing "quick" single pss computations for internal use.

variables.name: mInternalAllMemPssCount
variables.comment: Count and total time expended doing "quick" all mem pss computations for internal use.

variables.name: mInternalAllPollPssCount
variables.comment: Count and total time expended doing "quick" all poll pss computations for internal use.

variables.name: mExternalPssCount
variables.comment: Count and total time expended doing "quick" pss computations due to external requests.

variables.name: mExternalSlowPssCount
variables.comment: Count and total time expended doing full/slow pss computations due to external requests.

variables.comment: For writing parcels.

methods.name: public void dumpFilteredAssociationStatesProtoForProc(ProtoOutputStream proto, long fieldId, long now, ProcessState procState, final SparseArray<ArraySet<String>> uidToPkgMap)
methods.comment:
* Dump the association states related to given process into statsd. * *

Note: Only dump the single-package process state, or the common process state of * multi-package process; while the per-package process state of a multi-package process * should not be dumped into the statsd due to its incompletion.

* * @param proto The proto output stream * @param fieldId The proto output field ID * @param now The timestamp when the dump was initiated. * @param procState The target process where its association states should be dumped. * @param uidToPkgMap The map between UID to packages with this UID
